name: VC Trader AI Publish Report
description: Files a structured, block-bodied report in the workspace report library. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF at POST /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/reports as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN, ADR 0078), forwarding X-OpenClaw-Thread so the BFF resolves the calling specialist as the author. DIRECT_CONTROL per core/openclaw/allowlist.py - it writes straight through, with no staged descriptor and no human Apply. Publishing does NOT deliver: send_notification with a report attachment is what puts it in front of the reader.
